sourceModificationScope: Numbers auto-saved the scratch copy while opening/exporting. The original corpus remains unchanged; the saved copy is retained as an artifact with its own hash. No cell content was edited.

exportOptions.office: XLSX, one worksheet per table, no summary worksheet or password.
exportOptions.pdf: Best image quality; fit each entire source sheet onto one page; no comments/password.

license: Existing upstream MIT fixture notice recorded in IWorkCorpus/README.md; exported derivatives retain that provenance.
fontProvenance: Installed macOS fonts and native embedded PDF subsets only; no standalone font files are distributed.
qualification: Apple exports one XLSX worksheet per source table and a title row; comparisons map table names and shift rows by one.
All 529 populated cached/text/number cells with native values match, including 109 formula caches. One SUM(#REF!) formula has no native cache; OfficeIMO reports an approximate generic error.
Worksheet ordering, complete formula-expression equivalence, cache freshness, recalculation, and appearance are not qualified. Formula rich text still requires explicit partial acceptance.
